v4.pergunta: This is the 'objeto' (subject) of a Brazilian public procurement notice, written in Portuguese. Is the public body contracting, accrediting or selling to a bank or financial institution the service of paying its servants' salaries — processing, managing, centralizing or crediting the payroll ('folha de pagamento') into the servants' accounts — or the exclusive right to do so? Judge what is being CONTRACTED, not words that are merely mentioned.
v4.sim: yes: a bank or financial institution will process, manage, centralize or pay the payroll credits of the servants, retirees or pensioners, or buys, receives or is accredited for the right to do so ('cessão onerosa', 'exclusividade', 'credenciamento') — even when other banking services (tax collection, supplier payments, payroll-deductible loans) are bundled in
v4.nao: no: the contract is something else — the public body only pays bank fees or tariffs ('tarifas bancárias') or file transmission services ('envio/retorno de arquivos'); payroll software or a payroll system, including the licensing ('cessão') of a system; payroll calculation, HR outsourcing or consulting by a company that is not a bank; only the channel for payroll-deductible loans ('consignações'); an institutional bank account or investments; training, events or unrelated goods and services

true.meaning: A bank or financial institution will run the payroll of the public body's servants.
includes: processing, managing or paying the payroll credits of the servants
buying or receiving the exclusive right to do so ('cessão onerosa', 'credenciamento')
the same contract bundling other banking services such as tax collection, supplier payments or payroll-deductible loans
a payroll-deductible loan product on its own ('empréstimo consignado')
consulting or studies about the payroll
bank fees or file transfer services paid by the body
